body: Source: GitHub issue #1058. 1. In packages/backlog-groom/lib/rank.mjs, adjust VERDICT_WEIGHT and LABEL_WEIGHT so a valid verdict does not clear the medium threshold (0.35) on its own: an unclustered valid P3-low issue stays in the low band, an unclustered valid P2-medium issue stays in the medium band, and an unclustered valid P1-high issue stays in the high band, while fixed issues score 0 so a valid issue always outranks a fixed one regardless of label or cluster size. 2. In .claude/backlog-groom-profile.json, add relabel to autonomyFloor (["close", "relabel"]).
criteria: Unclustered valid P3-low issues rank low, unclustered valid P2-medium issues rank medium, and unclustered valid P1-high issues rank high.
title: backlog-groom: allow valid issues to rank low and floor relabel in repo profile (#1058)
